title: The 5 best Kanban tools in 2026
summary: If your project's too complex for a to-do list, but not complex enough for a project management app, you need a Kanban app. Here are the 5 best Kanban tools.
body_markdown:
**Best for**


**Standout feature**


**Pricing**


Trello


Ease of use and best overall


Clean user interface


Free for 10 boards and users per workspace; paid plans from $6/month/user


Breeze


Simplicity


Freeform, doc-style card descriptions


From $14/month for a single user or $10/user/month for teams


****workstreams.ai


AI-powered Kanban


AI-generated descriptions and action lists


Free plan for unlimited tasks and up to 3 users; paid plans from $9.99/month/user


Sortd


Kanban within Gmail


Tight integration with Google Workspace


From $14/month/user


****Taskworld


Adding tasks to multiple Kanban projects at once


Shrink cards down to a single line of text


From $19/month/user
